items.t: HC Wainwright & Co. Maintains Buy on TMC The Metals Co, Lowers Price Target to $5.5
items.sum: HC Wainwright & Co. analyst Heiko F. Ihle maintains TMC The Metals Co (NASDAQ:TMC) with a Buy and lowers the price target from $11.75 to $5.5.
